findings.diagnosis: Checked rather than assumed, because a comma pair around a list with internal commas usually fails. Here every item repeats in, so the interpolation brackets itself: the reader tracks the anaphora, and in everything the previous chapters have described audibly closes the series before is a civilization resumes the spine. The comma repair is serviceable and rebuilding the sentence would cost the accumulation, which is the point of the construction. Kept, with the cost named: the resumption is a shade harder to find than it was with the dashes.
